instruction: Convert the image to PNG format and export it as 'cover.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported image via File > Export As dialog, changed filename to export.jpg, navigated JPEG quality options, and completed export in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, use Export As dialog, change filenames, handle JPEG export options, navigate file system within dialogs.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests format conversion (JPG to PNG) during export. Agent must change both filename and format extension in the Export As dialog, which changes the export options dialog.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the JPG image as PNG format. Evaluator uses vm_command_line with 'file' command to verify the exported file is a valid PNG, and check_include_exclude to validate output contains 'PNG image data'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'file' command on /home/user/Desktop/cover.png to identify file type at the exact path specified in the instruction.
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies PNG format via 'PNG image data' include pattern and file existence via 'cannot open'/'No such file' exclude patterns.
All instruction requirements are covered: PNG format conversion (include pattern), correct filename 'cover.png' (file path), and correct location Desktop (file path).
Parameter handling is correct: check_include_exclude receives the rules dict directly with 'include' and 'exclude' keys.
No postconfig needed since verification is file-based, not UI-dependent.
